title: 34 Phoenix Street, Dublin 10, Kilmainham, Co. Dublin
seoTitle: 34 Phoenix Street, Dublin 10, Kilmainham, Co. Dublin
description: Exceptional period artisan 780 sq.ft. property that was fully renovated with a double storey extension. Located off Sarsfield at the end of Inchicore.  Super warm home with a conservative C3 rating with underfloor heating. 2 bedrooms with a 5ft and 4ft bed with an ensuite & semi-solid natural ash floors. Porcelain tiled bathrooms with silent thermostatic power showers, Xeplair simply silent extractor fans & LED vanity lights.. Downstairs Guest toilet. Soundbloc boards installed. Designer kitchen with built-in whirlpool appliances. Wireless sound system with recessed ceiling speakers. Lounge has solid oak flooring and antique open fireplace. Venetian blinds throughout including 6 velux windows giving great natural light. Monitored HKC Certified alarm system. BS 3261 certified locks with Igloohome smart system. Both can be controlled remotely by mobile. Floored attic space via pull down Stirra. Loft aerial & satellite disk. Each room has an intercom and wired throughout with Co-ax and ethernet. Partially enclosed courtyard with secured rear pedestrian access for bins & bikes. Beside Liffey Gaels park (see Street view) with pedestrian overhead bridge to the Memorial Gardens. Web search Thomas Kinsella and The Ranch for a podcast of this blue collar area. Free on-street parking (no permits required). Standard references required. Affordability index set at 35%.
